item.title: Chile wildfires rage for third day, entire towns wiped out

item.title: Over 400 houses burnt down in fire at Ukhiya Rohingya camp
item.description: More than 400 houses have been burnt down in a devastating fire at a Rohingya camp in Cox’s Bazar’s Ukhiya.The fire originated at the Shafiullah Kata Rohingya camp's D-16 block in Cox’s Bazar’s Ukhiya around 3AM on Tuesday. item.title: University of Asia Pacific closed sine die
item.description: The University of Asia Pacific (UAP) has suspended all classes for an indefinite period following suspension of two teachers in the face of students' protest over Facebook posts involving female students wearing niqab.The decision was announced late on Monday (January 19) in an urgent notice signed by the university’s acting registrar.According to the notice, the current circumstances is not feasible to continue regular academic activities. item.title: Chankharpul case verdict deferred to Jan 26
item.description: As the verdict is not prepared, the International Crimes Tribunal (ICT)-1 on Tuesday will not announce its scheduled judgement in a crimes against humanity case over the killing of six people in Dhaka’s Chankharpul area.A three-member tribunal, led by Justice Md Golam Mortuza Mozumder, set the new date as the verdict is not prepared, prosecution informed media.The accused in the case are former Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Commissioner Habibur Rahman, former DMP Joint Commissioner Sudip Kumar

item.title: Evaly's Russell, Shamima arrested
item.description: Detective Branch of police have arrested e-commerce company Evaly Managing Director Mohammad Russell and Chairperson Shamima Nasrin from Dhanmondi area.Police said the couple have been warranted in 391 cases.A team of DB conducted a drive in the Dhanmondi area on Monday night and arrested them, said Deputy Commissioner (Media and Public Relations Division) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Muhammad Talebur Rahman.
